requirement: bml-inference-pipeline 8.6 (operation sub-DAGs implemented; complete GGUF integration remains open)

operations.matmul: Row-major rectangular signed products and ordered sums, including empty contractions and empty output shapes.
operations.rms_norm: Signed x and weights, mean squared magnitude plus positive epsilon, square root expanded through log2 and half scaling; fractional variances supported algebraically.
operations.rope: Every adjacent pair is rotated using the supplied cosine and sine nodes, including zero and negative coefficients.
operations.softmax: Natural exponential via exp2(x*LOG2_E), positive sum and reciprocal. No max/comparison stabilization is synthesized.
operations.swiglu: gate * sigmoid(gate) * up, natural exponential and unit sigmoid scale.

verification.dag: Independent topological interpreter checks every log argument and exponential result for finite-real validity. Oracles use independent fractions and native exp formulas.
verification.runtime: Each output is linearized, split into multiple 256-byte-target fragments, serialized, deserialized, validated and executed. A whitelist rejects native arithmetic and opaque operators; only One/Var/Const/Bml and stack manipulation occur.
verification.structural_errors: Shapes, invalid references, epsilon, dimension overflow, output reservation failure and extreme empty-output dimensions are checked without appending graph nodes.

limitations: Small bounded examples do not establish numerical stability or evaluability for arbitrary transformer activations.
These operation builders have not replaced build_transformer_dag or the native host operations in the causal artifact profile.
Owned constant pools are used in these operation tests; this is not proof of zero-copy GGUF weight binding.
RoPE trigonometric constants are supplied, not synthesized from real BML.
The runtime preserves native IEEE evaluation; finite-real intermediate checks here belong to the independent DAG test.
